title: Moraine Lake and Lake Louise Tour from Calgary - Canmore - Banff
includes: Great hospitality and a big smile.
Small group guaranteed with max 24 people
Pick-up & drop-off service from Calgary, Banff, Canmore.
Door-to-door pickup. We pick-up our dear guests from our meeting points (not included)
Meals & All Personal Expenses such as activity, admission fee, phone & travel insurance (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the magnificent scenes of Banff National Park with your small group tour. On this full-day tour, enjoy being picked up from Calgary, Banff or Canmore.

- Explore the dramatic Lake Louise and Moraine Lake. This iconic stop will offer the opportunity to explore the historic hotel and take some pictures of bright blue waters of Lake Louise.
(NOTE: MORAINE LAKE road is closed to public since 2023. No worries, we do have special licence and permit for that. Please note, Moraine lake can only be visited between January 1st - October 13th. Other times, we will replace this spot with Marble Canyon).

- Comprehensive: See everything that you must in Banff National Park in one day. Lake Louise, Moraine Lake, Banff town.

- Small group guarantee! A personalized experience. Feel like a family.

- Our guides will help you to take amazing pictures.

- Hustle-free. Leave the driving part to us and just immerse yourself with the amazing nature.
